reasoning_off.note: The API reference lists the thinking request field (type enabled or disabled, supported by the GLM-4.6 series and higher, default enabled). The thinking guide shows thinking.type disabled and the streamed reasoning_content delta, and calls GLM-4.6 hybrid thinking. Neither page documents a reasoning-token count in usage.
